faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes. Our Japan-side team has native Japanese nationals who can support client communication, planning, and project discussions.
faq.q2: Do you work with companies in Japan?
faq.a2: Yes. NexM is based in Japan and supports businesses that need websites, software, AI tools, and digital support.
faq.q3: Where is your development team located?
faq.a3: Our engineering team is Japan, Bangladesh and globally. This helps us provide flexible and cost-effective development support.
faq.a4: We build websites, software, dashboards, business systems, UI/UX designs, branding materials, and AI automation tools.
faq.q5: Can you help us use Nodi AI?
faq.a5: Yes. We can help you set up Nodi AI for customer replies, lead management, quotations, meeting booking, and sales automation.
faq.q6: Can we start with a small project first?
faq.a6: Yes. You can start with a website, landing page, UX audit, or small automation project before building a larger system.
faq.q7: How do you manage quality with a remote team?
faq.a7: We use clear planning, regular updates, design approval, testing, and post-launch support to keep the project organized.
faq.q8: Do you provide support after launch?
faq.a8: Yes. We can help with updates, bug fixes, performance improvement, and future feature development.
